description: footRoll 30 equals the break: the ball takes all 30 and the toe tip none. Offset (8, -16) turned 30: y' = 8 cos 30 + 16 sin 30 = 14.928203, z' = 8 sin 30 - 16 cos 30 = -9.856406, so z = 0.143594. The Limb is at IK, so its hand reaches the foot's ankle target: (4, 4, 0) + 0.1 * (P - (0, 8, -6)).
